currency_change_warning:
Changing the base currency will switch the currency unit of all bills and affect the automatic exchange rate conversion when creating new bills.

Example: If the previous functional currency was RMB, and you recorded a ¥100 expense, when the functional currency is switched to USD, the original bill will change to $100.

If you have previously recorded bills in a non-functional currency, the value converted to the functional currency will prevail.

Example: If the previous functional currency was RMB, and you recorded a $100 USD expense (assuming the converted value at that time was ¥700), when the functional currency is switched to USD, the original bill will change to $700.

preset_question.annual_summary.label: Annual Summary
preset_question.annual_summary.prompt:
Please generate an [Annual Ledger Summary] for me.

This is a comprehensive annual analysis task. Please follow these requirements:

1. Time range: Cover a complete calendar year (start and end dates should be based on the year corresponding to the current data, or as specified by the system/context, if not specified, and the current year is not over, the previous year is used).
2. This is a [Macro Statistics + Multi-dimensional Analysis] task. You can and should call the analyze_bills tool multiple times to complete statistics from different dimensions.
3. Please include at least the following analysis dimensions (you can extend as needed):
   - Annual total income, total expenses, and balance
   - Expense composition by [Category] (Top categories)
   - Expense trends by [Month] (identify volatile or anomalous months)
   - Average daily expenses & Maximum single-day expenses
   - Most frequent expense categories or tags (spending habits)
   - Whether there are obvious phase changes (e.g., beginning of year vs. end of year)
4. During the analysis process:
   - All conclusions must be based on real data obtained through tools
   - No subjective speculation is allowed
5. When outputting the final result, please:
   - Summarize in a natural, "annual review" narrative style
   - Provide 2-4 "data-based personal insights"
   - Provide 1-3 "improvement or recommendation directions for the next year"

Please begin your analysis.

proxy-help-free-desc: Hosted on Cloudflare Workers; it promises not to log anything, but still cannot be fully trusted.
proxy-help-how-desc: 胖记 appends the original URL to whatever you enter here:
proxy-help-lead: Relay requests through a proxy when your WebDAV server does not allow cross-origin requests.
proxy-help-method-desc: Some serverless proxies reject uncommon methods such as PROPFIND. Use the address below and 胖记 will send POST instead, carrying the real method in the method parameter:
proxy-help-security-desc: A proxy can read all traffic, including your WebDAV username and password. Only use one you host yourself or fully trust. Jianguoyun does not work with public proxies — you must self-host. For a quick trial, use a temporary account and delete it afterwards.
proxy-help-when-desc: Browsers refuse direct requests to WebDAV servers without CORS headers — Synology, self-hosted NAS and some cloud drives are closed by default. If you can add https://cent.linkai.work to the allowed origins on the server, skip the proxy.

s3-help-advanced-desc: Base directory defaults to cent — use it when several ledgers share one bucket. Session Token is only for temporary credentials, and Force Path Style is only for MinIO-like gateways.
s3-help-cors-desc: 胖记 reads and writes the bucket from the browser, so the bucket needs CORS: allow the origin below, methods GET / PUT / HEAD / DELETE. 403 usually means the key lacks permission or Region is wrong; NoSuchBucket means the name and region don't match.
s3-help-cors-title: Configure CORS first if it fails
s3-help-endpoint-desc: Enter the endpoint host from your provider's console, with https:// and no bucket name or path appended. Tapping a provider above fills it in.
s3-help-key-desc: Create them under Access Keys / API Keys in the console; the secret is shown once. Prefer a sub-account limited to this one bucket so it can be revoked on its own.
s3-help-lead: Your data lives in your own bucket; 胖记 only reads and writes it. Works with AWS S3, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS, Cloudflare R2, MinIO and other compatible services.
s3-help-region-desc: Region is the region code such as us-east-1, oss-cn-hangzhou or ap-guangzhou, and must match the bucket's region — a mismatch fails at signing. Keep the bucket private; no public read is needed, since 胖记 signs requests with your key.
